exposure: Duration of double-balloon device placement (6 hours vs 12 hours)
removal of a double-balloon device for cervical ripening
cohort: 197 women undergoing cervical ripening with a double-balloon device (101 nulliparous and 96 parous)
finding: Insertion-to-delivery interval was significantly shorter for women who had the double-balloon device removed after 6 hours compared to 12 hours, without affecting cervical ripening or cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was similar between the 6-hour and 12-hour groups.
